prompt: A chaotic pirate ship battle on a stormy sea. A large pirate galleon is next to a smaller naval brig; the galleon is longer than the brig. A giant kraken has surfaced between the two ships, wrapping a massive tentacle around the brig's main mast and breaking it. The tentacle is thicker than the mast. The pirate captain, who has a hook for a hand and is taller than the naval officer, stands at the galleon's wheel. He has two gold coins in his pocket. He is pointing a sword at a naval officer on the brig's deck. On the galleon's deck are four cannons, and their number is twice the number of gold coins in the captain's pocket. One of the cannons is firing towards the brig. A parrot is perched on the pirate captain's shoulder, trying to snatch one of the gold coins. The naval officer is holding a telescope, which is shorter than the pirate captain's sword, and is looking at the pirate captain. A treasure chest sits on the deck, chained to the base of the galleon's main mast. The kraken is pushing the galleon with another tentacle. The naval officer is standing in front of his ship's broken mast. There are more pirates on the galleon's deck than naval sailors on the brig's deck. The kraken is looking at the galleon.
